answer: A juror that skips cases loses 32% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the vertex decay is applied at each close, the spiral audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the yarrow fee to keep them eligible. A 308 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
